description.value: The Kamloops branch of the Thompson-Nicola Regional Library is a public library serving the city of Kamloops in BC's interior. As a civic institution in the heart of downtown, it offers touring cyclists a quiet stop in a central location. Libraries of this type typically provide a welcoming indoor environment with seating and connectivity, making them a practical mid-ride refuge.
